090 'Agag {a-gag'}

字源不詳, 與 SNH00089 比較; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Agag 8; 8

亞甲 = "我會在萬人之上"
1) 亞瑪力人的王, 掃羅留存其性命, 但仍為撒母耳所殺

090 'Agag {ag-ag'} or 'Agag {Ag-awg'}

of uncertain derivation, compare with 089;; n pr m

AV - Agag 8; 8

Agag = "I will overtop"
1) king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel
